Research Interpretation
Each marker represents a representative administrative point for a kabupaten/kota explicitly detected in a post. It must not be interpreted as the exact physical coordinate of the disaster event. Multi-location posts appear as separate spatial records.
Spatial semantics: representative administrative location.
CRS: EPSG:4326 (WGS 84).
